identity: d/dalpha I_u((1-alpha)x + alpha e_l) = G_{u,l} - I_u  with  G_{u,l} = (c_l^T K^{-1} M_u)^2/(2 nu_l),  M_u = Delta_u a_u/q_u
why_this_matters: M_u is the PROFILED contrast Delta_u a_u/(a_u^T K^{-1} a_u), not a free vector.  Writing G with a free M is what lets a matrix witness stand in for an instrument model.
rank_rule: G is the entrywise square of B, so rank(G) <= rank(B)(rank(B)+1)/2; a rank-one B gives a rank-one G, a rank-two B gives rank <= 3
not_established: This is a numerical verification of the derivative identity and the rank bound; it is not a Lean theorem.
kappa_l enters only as the budget normalisation; the identity above is stated per unit of design mass, and the priced version divides by kappa_l.
No optimality of any design is claimed here.
